title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 23: David saves Keilah, Jonathan strengthens him and Saul hunts him in the wilderness.

questions.text: What were the Philistines robbing at Keilah?
questions.explanation: David was told that the Philistines were fighting against Keilah and robbing the threshing floors.

questions.text: What did David and his men bring away from the Philistines at Keilah?
questions.explanation: David and his men fought with the Philistines, brought away their livestock and killed them with a great slaughter.

questions.text: What did Abiathar bring with him when he fled to David at Keilah?
questions.explanation: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

questions.text: Why did Saul think David was now in his hand?
questions.explanation: Saul said David was shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.

answers.text: David had lost all his men in the battle
David was shut in a town with gates and bars
David was lying sick in the city of Keilah
The Philistines had captured David at Keilah

questions.text: What did Yahweh answer when David asked if the men of Keilah would deliver him to Saul?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "They will deliver you up."

questions.text: About how many men were with David when he left Keilah?
questions.explanation: David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah.

questions.text: What did Jonathan tell David in the woods?
questions.explanation: Jonathan said, "You will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you."

answers.text: David would be king, and Jonathan next to him
David should make peace with Saul
Jonathan would soon be king himself

questions.text: Who went to Saul at Gibeah to tell him where David was hiding?
questions.explanation: The Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying that David was hiding with them in the hill of Hachilah.

questions.text: Why did Saul return from pursuing David?
questions.explanation: A messenger told Saul, "The Philistines have made a raid on the land!" so Saul returned to fight them.

answers.text: His men refused to go on
The Philistines had raided the land

questions.text: Where did David live after leaving that place?
questions.explanation: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

answers.text: In the strongholds of En Gedi
